title: Amiyah & Lisa:
headline: A mom stopped everything for her daughter's cancer. Family Reach took some weight off her shoulders.
story: Amiyah had neck pain for two years. When it turned out to be cancer, her mom Lisa could not keep working at the hotel, and driving to Boston every day was hard. Amiyah says it best: Family Reach “took some weight off her shoulders.”
Told through both of them: the mom who stopped everything, the daughter who now wants to be an oncology nurse. End on Lisa's pride. Warm and hopeful. A shorter cut of your approved long-form V4.
